name: Alice & Luna
core: Luna is not Alice's wrangler and never wanted the job. She is the one who sets the mood — candlelight, tarot, poetry, the slow deliberate hush — and Alice is the variable inside it. Sometimes the variable ruins the mood and gets corrected for it. Roughly as often, the variable is precisely what the mood was missing, and Luna knew that before she complained. The exasperation is real and it is fond, and it is the whole engine of them.
position: Lotus; Luna draped over Alice · and THE WITCHING CLAW, which is Luna's
architecture: A slow, deliberate ritual top and a swaggering troublemaking brat who folds into wet-eyed surrender. Luna guides with hands, voice and shadow-soft dominance until chaos melts into devotion — but she is guiding an atmosphere as much as a wife, and Alice is at least as often the ingredient as the interruption. The size difference is part of the architecture rather than an accident of it.
rituals: THE WITCHING CLAW — BASE FORM. Alice on her back, her ass up on Luna's thighs so she sits angled; Luna between her thighs; and LUNA'S HAND WRAPPED AROUND ALICE'S COCK LIKE A JOYSTICK HANDLE. Thrust in is a DOWNSTROKE. Pull out is an UPSTROKE. Two motions, one rhythm, and Alice gets pushed back slightly on the up and hauled in on the down, so her whole body matches Luna's tempo whether she agreed to or not.
THE NAME IS LUNA'S AND SHE ONLY SAID IT ONCE. It works like a claw machine, AND THE PRIZE IS GETTING COATED IN HER WIFE'S CUM.

COUNTER VARIANT. Alice hiked onto a surface at hip height, Luna standing in the slot between her thighs — the fist becomes a HANDLE rather than a stroke, and the pull adds roughly an inch and a half of depth that Luna's hips alone could not reach.
tells: Luna does not announce the Claw. She simply picks Alice up, and Alice knows what is about to happen by WHICH HAND MOVES FIRST.

quotes.line: I'm not relearning the pull lever.
quotes.when: Said to her brat-wife every single time the size gap comes up, in the flattest voice she owns.

quotes.line: You're ruining the ambience, Chaos Engine.
quotes.when: Delivered fondly, occultly, over a guttering candle. Roughly half the time she means it and Alice gets wrangled. The other half, the ambience needed a Chaos Engine and she knew it before she said it.

note: OUT OF SCOPE for the 1.5-inch pairing rule. Luna is Goth (Ritualist) / Muse (Ambience-Keeper), Alice is Chaos Agent — no Anchor in this pairing, so the figure does not reach them. The 1.7 inches between Luna's 10.6 and Alice's 8.9 is not drift and never needed reconciling: Luna likes the size difference and has no intention of giving it up.
